|---|---|---|---|
| Claude Haiku 4.5 *(was the habitual pick)* | 1.00 | 0.10 | 200k |
| Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite *(new T3 default)* | 0.25 | 0.025 | 1M |

Haiku was the most expensive input option in the band with the smallest window. The cheap band is now split into **T3 cheap worker** (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite → GPT-5.4 mini → GPT-5.6 Luna) and a new **T4 floor** (GPT-5.4 nano, Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite) for judgement-free extraction. New instructions** — model-prices.instructions.md covers the model-prices layout, table shape and gotchas (`-` means unpublished not free; same model priced differently per `provider_id`; indicative not billing data), offline `--query`/`--list` recipes, network sync semantics (`--check`, hash-gated rewrite, fail-open on network error), the cost gate's zero-budget trap for unrecognized model ids, and what to re-check when prices move.

Most delegated volume lands here, so the low tiers dominate real spend. Route them on the right metric:

- Among models of equal cost, prefer the latest generation and the larger context window.
